annotations.scope: Actual page Annots ownership, unique NM per page, same-page IRT and RT grouping relationships, parent/popup reciprocal ownership; shared resource object identity does not confer annotation ownership.

remoteActions.scope: GoToR and GoToE D versus SD destination branches, remote page integers, file requirements and recursively bounded target paths. No I/O or target-file existence inference.

rectilinearMeasures.scope: Normalized RL measure arrays, required units/format members, fractional denominator and origin/CYX relationships. Foreign Measure subtypes remain opaque; no universal positive-C or power-of-ten constraint is invented.

boundaries: These graph checks are separate from the 197 intrinsic dictionary rules and the four approved EC3 semantic corrections.
They do not implement every conditional annotation/action/measurement requirement, execute actions, open external resources, render appearances or establish complete ISO conformance.
